segments.name: nCino Platform
segments.description: Provides financial institutions of all sizes with cloud-based platform solutions for onboarding, lending, account opening, credit monitoring, and integration and intelligence.
segments.evidence: As such, the Company has one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Financial institutions pay subscription fees for access to nCino's solutions and maintenance, plus professional services fees for implementation, configuration, training and advisory work.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive our revenues from subscription and professional services and other revenues.
